LanguageData.LPMB_Relation_SuanniFireGiant.stages.0.d: Fire giant forge craftsmanship is the real thing, of one mind with enlightening objects.
LanguageData.LPMB_Relation_FireGiantSuanni.stages.0.d: That suanni can tell good forging from bad at a glance; a real connoisseur.
LanguageData.LPMB_Relation_JumangElf.stages.0.label: friend of the woods
LanguageData.LPMB_Relation_JumangElf.stages.0.descrip: Elves know how to tend plants, sharing the same roots as the power of spring.
LanguageData.LPMB_Relation_ElfJumang.stages.0.label: scion of the spring god
LanguageData.LPMB_Relation_ElfJumang.stages.0.descrip: When the goumang comes, even the woods feel more alive.
LanguageData.LPMB_Relation_JumangFireGiant.stages.0.d: Fire giants bring smoke and fire wherever they go, giving the plants no peace.
LanguageData.LPMB_Relation_FireGiantJumang.stages.0.d: The goumang keeps complaining that the forge burns trees. What a busybody.
LanguageData.LPMB_Relation_BaizeMindFlayer.stages.0.d: The baize knows the form of all things, yet can't see through the mind behind those tentacles. Chilling.
LanguageData.LPMB_Relation_MindFlayerBaize.stages.0.d: That baize's gaze feels like it's dissecting my mind.
LanguageData.LPMB_Relation_BaizeLich.stages.0.label: defying fate
LanguageData.LPMB_Relation_BaizeLich.stages.0.descrip: The lich escapes destiny with a phylactery; the baize is uneasy looking at it.
LanguageData.LPMB_Relation_LichBaize.stages.0.label: scrutiny of the fate-knower
LanguageData.LPMB_Relation_LichBaize.stages.0.descrip: The baize keeps sizing up my fate. Annoying.
LanguageData.LPMB_Relation_TaotieTroll.stages.0.label: fellow eater
LanguageData.LPMB_Relation_TaotieTroll.stages.0.descr: Trolls have bottomless appetites just like me; eating together is great.
LanguageData.LPMB_Relation_TrollTaotie.stages.0.label: hearty taotie
LanguageData.LPMB_Relation_TrollTaotie.stages.0.descr: The taotie eats even more than me; finally nobody looks down on my appetite.
LanguageData.LPMB_Relation_TaotieDwarf.stages.0.label: food-guarding dwarf
LanguageData.LPMB_Relation_TaotieDwarf.stages.0.descr: Dwarves hide their wine and meat tight and won't share a bite.
LanguageData.LPMB_Relation_DwarfTaotie.stages.0.label: thieving taotie
LanguageData.LPMB_Relation_DwarfTaotie.stages.0.descr: That taotie keeps eyeing my wine barrels and cured meat.
